shell.powershell:
$existingZ = Get-Command z -ErrorAction Ignore
if ($existingZ -and (($script:ZLUA_SCRIPT -ne (Join-Path $PikoPackageRoot 'z.lua')) -or ($script:ZLUA_LUAEXE -ne $PikoDependencies['lua']))) { throw 'An existing z command or z.lua initialization was detected; remove it manually before enabling Piko z.lua.' }
$lua = $PikoDependencies['lua']
$script = Join-Path $PikoPackageRoot 'z.lua'
Invoke-Expression ((& $lua $script --init powershell) -join "`n")
